description: Scam/rug risk check for a Solana SPL or Token-2022 token mint. Returns a 0-100 risk score (HIGHER = RISKIER), a verdict, and flags with plain-English reasons: mint/freeze authority, permanent delegate, transfer hooks/fees, holder concentration, liquidity, LP burn/lock %, Streamflow locks and a simulated buy+sell (honeypot test). Read-only; never signs or trades.
name: check_solana_token
